name: Something answering on the port is a gate refusal, and three in a row fail the cycle
description: A separate HTTP server occupied the configured port. Three seam-answered-before-boot refusals were followed by three gate-refusal effects, the cycle failed at gate for infrastructure, and the candidate launch marker was absent.
